<span id="bricks-one-page-each"></span>
== Bricks (one page each) ==

* [[Company Brain/awdk|awdk]] — the core: agents, memory, model routing, the <code>adk</code> CLI
* [[Company Brain/awdiscord|awdiscord]] — an agent on Discord as a real bot
* [[Company Brain/awbrain|awbrain]] — your notes as a wiki of linked Markdown, claims pinned to source lines

The full family is about 70 bricks. This wiki covers three so far.
